@MeasureTheory.integral_prod : ∀ {α : Type u_1} {β : Type u_2} {E : Type u_3} [inst : MeasurableSpace.{u_1} α] [inst_1 : MeasurableSpace.{u_2} β]
  {μ : MeasureTheory.Measure.{u_1} α} {ν : MeasureTheory.Measure.{u_2} β} [inst_2 : NormedAddCommGroup.{u_3} E]
  [MeasureTheory.SFinite.{u_2} ν] [inst_4 : NormedSpace.{0, u_3} ℝ E] [MeasureTheory.SFinite.{u_1} μ]
  (f : Prod.{u_1, u_2} α β → E),
  MeasureTheory.Integrable.{u_3, max u_1 u_2} f (MeasureTheory.Measure.prod.{u_1, u_2} μ ν) →
    Eq.{u_3 + 1} (∫ (z : Prod.{u_1, u_2} α β), f z ∂MeasureTheory.Measure.prod.{u_1, u_2} μ ν)
      (∫ (x : α), ∫ (y : β), f (Prod.mk.{u_1, u_2} x y) ∂ν ∂μ)

'MeasureTheory.integral_prod' depends on axioms: [propext, Classical.choice.{u}, Quot.sound.{u}]
